description: Edit a video. Basic: trim, extract_frame, extract_frames, convert, gif, compress, resize, add_audio, remove_audio, speed. Cinematic: color_grade, transition, text_overlay, picture_in_picture, split_screen, ken_burns, slow_motion, watermark, concatenate, audio_mix, auto_caption. Requires ffmpeg (ImageMagick for text/captions, whisper.cpp for auto_caption).

_account.description: Optional. Override identity for THIS call: pass the AgenticMail agent name (e.g. "Fola") to authenticate as that agent. Requires AGENTICMAIL_ACCOUNT_KEYS_JSON to contain a matching key. Omit to use the default identity (AGENTICMAIL_API_KEY).

audioPath.description: Path to an audio file (add_audio, audio_mix).

bgVolume.description: Background audio volume for audio_mix. Default: 0.3.

colorPreset.description: Colour grade preset: warm, cool, vintage, cinematic, dramatic, bleach, noir, vivid, muted, golden_hour.

fgVolume.description: Foreground audio volume for audio_mix. Default: 1.0.

format.description: Output format: mp4, webm, mov, avi, mkv.

input.description: Absolute path to the input video (or image for ken_burns). Not required for concatenate.

lutPath.description: Path to a .cube LUT file for color_grade.

pipPosition.description: PiP position: top-left, top-right, bottom-left, bottom-right.

textBg.description: Text background colour with opacity, e.g. "black@0.5".

textPosition.description: Text position: center, top, bottom, top-left, top-right, bottom-left, bottom-right.

transitionType.description: Transition type: fade, wipeleft, slideright, circlecrop, etc. Default: fade.

watermarkPosition.description: Watermark position: top-left, top-right, bottom-left, bottom-right, center.

whisperModel.description: Absolute path to a whisper.cpp model file (.bin) — required for auto_caption.

zoomDirection.description: Ken Burns: zoom_in, zoom_out, pan_left, pan_right, pan_up, pan_down.

zoomDuration.description: Ken Burns output duration in seconds. Default: 5.

name: media_video_edit
